description_en: Queries the auto-renewal status of a subscription AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoRenewAttribute接口查询包年包月集群自动续费状态
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-auto-renew-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-ids am-bp11q28kvl6880000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --resource-group-id rg-4690g379290000 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Separate multiple clusters with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
如果有多个集群ID，以英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
